subj: New Feature: See What Buyers Say About Your Company on FindLight
text:
Dear Vendor,



We are excited to announce a new feature that gives you more visibility into how buyers are engaging with your company on FindLight.



Two business days after a buyer submits a Request for Quote (RFQ) through FindLight, we follow up with a short survey asking whether they received a response and how satisfied they were with the experience. Based on this, we generate performance metrics for your company:





Average NPS Score (1–10)


Response Rate


Buyer Comments (optional feedback)





These insights help you understand how your responsiveness and communication are perceived and can highlight areas for growth or celebrate what you’re doing well.



To view your buyer feedback, log into your FindLight account and navigate to My Account → Buyer Feedback.












Frequently Asked Questions

What is the NPS Score?


NPS (Net Promoter Score) is a 1–10 rating that reflects how satisfied a buyer was with their experience and how likely they are to recommend your company.



What is the Response Rate?


This measures whether you responded to the buyer’s RFQ within 48 hours. It’s based on the percentage of buyers who answered “Yes” to “Did the vendor reply?”



What are Buyer Comments?


Buyers are also asked a standardized multiple-choice question and may select more than one answer.



Learn more at: https://www.findlight.net/how-buyer-feedback-works














We believe this feature will help foster transparency, trust, and stronger relationships between you and your customers.



If you have any questions or suggestions, please email us at contact@findlight.net.



Best regards,


The FindLight Team
